_comments.region: fra1 = Frankfurt. Non-negotiable GDPR data residency requirement (AR-13, devops-engineer.md). Never change to a non-EU region.
_comments.csp_mode: CSP is Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only (report-only, NOT enforced). This is intentional per devops-engineer.md §8.3 and architecture.md §8.2: deploy report-only first, observe violations in Sentry CSP reporting endpoint on preview, then promote to enforced Content-Security-Policy header in Phase 5 pre-launch QA. Do NOT change to enforced before Phase 5 sign-off.
_comments.hsts_preload: HSTS preload is intentionally ABSENT. Per architecture.md §8.3 and security-model.md §7 Rule 5: preload is added only after 60+ days of stable production. A misconfiguration in the first week would lock all browsers to HTTPS for 2 years. Post-launch task: add 'preload' at day 60+ and submit victaagency.com to https://hstspreload.org.
_comments.chat_function: api/chat maxDuration is defined here even though the chatbot is deferred post-launch (D-002). Keeping the config in place avoids forgetting the 10-second timeout when chatbot is reactivated. Cost protection requirement: security-model.md §4.1, architecture.md §8.1.
_comments.csp_enforcement: Phase 5 pre-launch task: change 'Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only' to 'Content-Security-Policy' in the headers array below after observing zero violations on preview deployments. Requires Roman sign-off (D-006).

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://consent.cookiebot.com https://consentcdn.cookiebot.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://imgsct.cookiebot.com https://www.google-analytics.com; connect-src 'self' https://consent.cookiebot.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.supabase.co https://*.upstash.io; frame-src 'self' https://app.cal.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; report-to csp-endpoint;
